name: context-decision
description: Decision continuity with rationale, rejected alternatives, conflict checks, and superseded history.

interface.shortDescription: Remember what was decided, why, and what not to follow.
interface.longDescription: Preserves an accepted decision, its rationale, and rejected alternatives as one authoritative record; recalls the current choice and marks superseded history do_not_follow. Requires the user to prepare the exact context-core distribution manually.
defaultPrompt: Before any repository operation, require the exact enabled context-core@jeis-ai-plugins source, context-common/v1 protocol, and doctor repository_state=ready.
Use $context-decision:decision only for an explicit accepted choice with scope and commitment; keep the decision, rationale, and rejected alternatives together.
Never install, enable, update, initialize, or physically write on the user's behalf; final approved writes belong to the context-core coordinator.
